```{r}
# packages
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(lubridate)

```

## Encounters Over Time

```{r ENCOUNTERS}
# paths
encounters_dir <- "data/encounters"
processed_dir <- file.path(encounters_dir, "processed")

encounters_final_path <- file.path(
  processed_dir,
  "encounters_final.parquet"
)

setwd("/Users/simone/Desktop/DDP/cbp")

# select date data
weekly_encounters <- encounters_final_path |>
  open_dataset() |>
  select(
    encounter_datetime,
    apprehension_datetime,
    apprehension_date
  ) |>
  mutate(
    event_date = coalesce(
      as.Date(encounter_datetime),
      as.Date(apprehension_datetime),
      apprehension_date),
    week_start = floor_date(
      event_date,
      unit = "week",
      week_start = 1
    )
    ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(week_start)
  ) |>
  count(
    week_start,
    name = "encounter_count"
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  arrange(
    week_start
  )

# plot
ggplot(
  weekly_encounters,
  aes(
    x = week_start,
    y = encounter_count
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 year",
    date_labels = "%Y"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly USBP Encounters",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Encounter Count",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Customs and Border Protection"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# flag which dataset each obs comes from

```

## Apprehensions Over Time

```{r APPREHENSIONS }
# paths
apprehensions_dir <- "data/apprehensions"
processed_dir <- file.path(apprehensions_dir, "processed")

apprehensions_final_path <- file.path(
  processed_dir,
  "apprehensions_final.parquet"
)

setwd("/Users/simone/Desktop/DDP/cbp")

# select date data
weekly_apprehensions <- apprehensions_final_path |>
  open_dataset() |>
  select(
    apprehension_datetime,
    apprehension_date,
    arrest_datetime,
    arrest_date
  ) |>
  mutate(
    event_date = coalesce(
      as.Date(apprehension_datetime),
      apprehension_date,
      as.Date(arrest_datetime),
      arrest_date),
    week_start = floor_date(
      event_date,
      unit = "week",
      week_start = 1
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(week_start)
  ) |>
  count(
    week_start,
    name = "apprehension_count"
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  arrange(
    week_start
  )


# plot
ggplot(
  weekly_apprehensions,
  aes(
    x = week_start,
    y = apprehension_count
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 year",
    date_labels = "%Y"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly USBP Apprehensions",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Apprehension Count",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Customs and Border Protection"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
